_comment: Passive effects per item. Key is "<item_id>#<n>"; n is the order the passives are applied and shown in. Mechanics are named by "kind" and declared in game/passives/_kinds_*.py — an item can only name a kind, never define one. Every other field is a NUMBER at the top level, deliberately: game/remote_content/gamedata.py patches flat numeric fields only, so keeping the shape flat is what makes any single passive's numbers fixable without a Play release, while "item" and "kind" stay unpatchable because they are strings. Player-facing prose lives in the item's own special_effect field, so it ships through the language packs.
